message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich.p2: The phylactery cracks, and soul fire pours out of the lich's sockets.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich.p3: The phylactery breaks. The lich burns with everything it has bound.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.acererak.p2: Acererak's gems blaze, and the skulls of the Devoured begin to circle him faster.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.acererak.p3: The Eternal Lich rises: every gem in his crown is a soul, and all of them scream.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vecna.p2: The Hand of Vecna ignites and the Eye opens: he sees everyone in the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vecna.p3: Vecna is whole again. The Hand burns, the Eye is wide open, and the web closes.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.strahd.p2: Strahd tears his cape open: leathery wings, and the bats come down from the rafters.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.strahd.p3: The Devil of Barovia is the swarm. His eyes burn and the floor runs with red mist.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.zariel.p2: Zariel's wings catch fire and the plate begins to glow.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.zariel.p3: The Archduchess of Avernus unfolds a second pair of wings; her halo closes into a ring of fire.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.asmodeus.p2: Asmodeus spreads his wings and the hall fills with the heat of the Nine Hells.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.asmodeus.p3: The wings burn along every vein, the horns grow tall, and a ring of hellfire opens behind the Archdevil.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.orcus.p2: The gut of Orcus splits and soul fire shows in the wound.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.orcus.p3: Ribs break out of the demon prince; a crowd of souls rises with him.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich_king.p2: Ice crystals break through the Lich King's armour and the runeblade sings.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lich_king.p3: The Frozen Throne answers: a ring of runes opens under the Lich King.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.solar.p2: A second pair of wings unfolds behind the Solar and the sunburst turns.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.solar.p3: Six wings, a full halo and a bow drawn to the ear: the Solar judges the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.demogorgon.p: Both of Demogorgon's heads open their eyes and the barbs on his tentacles light up.
The Prince of Demons crowns both heads in horns and the air round him whirls dark purple.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.beholder.p2: The Beholder's eyestalks flare: every ray is awake.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.beholder.p3: Four more stalks tear free and the central eye opens its cone of nothing.
The jar cracks. The Elder Brain swells and the whole hall hums.
The jar bursts. A bare brain, ringed with psionic light, hangs among its own glass.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.kraken.p2: The Kraken's lights blaze and four more arms climb out from under it.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.kraken.p3: Lightning crawls over the Kraken's mantle: the black tide is about to break.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tiamat.p2: All five mouths of Tiamat fill with their own breath.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tiamat.p3: Tiamat's wings spread to their full span and the five colours circle her necks.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.bahamut.p2: Bahamut's eyes blaze and a halo of platinum light opens behind him.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.bahamut.p3: The Platinum Dragon spreads his wings: a corona of light fills the hall.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.dracolich.p2: Soul fire swells in the Dracolich's ribs and its skull ignites.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.dracolich.p3: The phylactery rises over its back, and the dead dragon burns white.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tarrasque.p2: The carapace of the Tarrasque begins to shimmer: spells will come back.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.tarrasque.p3: The mirror-carapace blazes. Nothing that is cast at the Tarrasque stays cast.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lolth.p2: Four more legs rise behind Lolth like a crown of black blades.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.lolth.p3: A second pair of arms, eight burning eyes and a blazing hourglass: the Spider Queen is whole.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.quasit.p2: The Quasit's wings unfurl and its tail ignites.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.quasit.p3: A ring of fire circles the Quasit as its horns and claws lengthen.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vrock.p2: Spores rise from the Vrock's wings.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.vrock.p3: Violet fire runs along the Vrock's wings and its eyes swell.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.hezrou.p2: The spines of the Hezrou glow and acid drips from its jaw.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.hezrou.p3: The Hezrou swells: eyes huge, crest raised, the stench so thick the air turns green.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.balor.p2: The cracks in the Balor's skin open and its wings catch fire along the veins.
message.nusmp.mega.dnd.look.balor.p3: The Balor is ablaze from horn to hoof.
